ModMetaData.name: RandomPlusPlus
ModMetaData.author: hsariaslan
ModMetaData.description:
Allow users to set minimum specifications for pawn generation when using the randomize button. It will keep rerolling until the minimum specification is met or it passes the max reroll limit.
This mod is forked from RandomPlus mod created by mastertea (special thanks), added below improvements to that mod.
To use this mod, you should disable that mod to avoid conflicts. This mod already covers all features of RandomPlus mod.
- Added UltraFast mode that is ~5-10x faster than Fast mode. - Added higher reroll limits up to 1B (this can take hours to finish). - Right clicking or focusing out the window would cancel the iteration immediately and gracefully, useful for cancelling higher rerolls like 1B. - Added pregnancy support to Only Start Conditions option in Health Conditions filter. - Added Forced Violence option to Incapable Of filter. - Added Blacklist traits as well as Whitelist traits. - Added time elapsed while randomizing information.
Source code: https://github.com/hsariaslan/RandomPlusPlus
